modelMetadata.description: Power BI model analyzing graduate statistics from Statistics Canada

tables.name: DataFileRecordLayout
tables.description: Main fact table containing graduate statistics from Statistics Canada

measures.name: Total Graduates
measures.description: Base aggregation of graduate counts

measures.name: Female Graduates
measures.description: Total graduates filtered for women - Optimized to use direct SUM
measures.optimizationNotes: Removed measure dependency, uses direct SUM

measures.name: Male Graduates
measures.description: Total graduates filtered for men

measures.name: Female Percentage
measures.description: Percentage of female graduates

measures.name: Male Percentage
measures.description: Percentage of male graduates

measures.name: Gender Balance Ratio
measures.expression:
VAR FemaleCount = [Female Graduates]
VAR MaleCount = [Male Graduates]
VAR MinValue = MIN(FemaleCount, MaleCount)
VAR MaxValue = MAX(FemaleCount, MaleCount)
RETURN
    DIVIDE(MinValue, MaxValue, BLANK())
measures.description: Gender diversity ratio (closer to 1.0 means more balanced)

measures.name: Number of Provinces
measures.description: Count of distinct geographic regions

measures.name: Avg Graduates per Province
measures.description: Average graduates per province

measures.name: Province Rank by Graduates
measures.expression:
IF(
    ISINSCOPE('DataFileRecordLayout'[GEO]),
    RANKX(
        ALLSELECTED('DataFileRecordLayout'[GEO]),
        [Total Graduates],
        ,
        DESC,
        DENSE
    ),
    BLANK()
)
measures.description: Rank provinces by number of graduates (1=highest)

measures.name: First Year
measures.description: Earliest year in the dataset

measures.name: Last Year
measures.description: Most recent year in the dataset

measures.name: Latest Year Graduates
measures.expression:
VAR MaxYear = MAX('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE])
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Graduates],
        'DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE] = MaxYear
    )
measures.description: Graduates in the most recent year available - Fixed to avoid placeholder errors
measures.optimizationNotes: Fixed placeholder error by using variable instead of measure in filter

measures.name: Cumulative Graduates
measures.description: Running total of graduates over time

measures.name: Graduates YofY Change (%)
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentValue = SUM('DataFileRecordLayout'[VALUE])
VAR CurrentYear = SELECTEDVALUE('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE])
VAR PriorYearValue = 
    CALCULATE(
        SUM('DataFileRecordLayout'[VALUE]),
        'DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE] = FORMAT(VALUE(CurrentYear) - 1, "0")
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(
        CurrentValue - PriorYearValue,
        PriorYearValue,
        BLANK()
    )
measures.description: Year-over-year percentage change - Optimized with direct SUM and better error handling
measures.optimizationNotes: Major refactoring: cached values, removed dependencies, improved year handling

measures.name: Graduates YoY Change (Absolute)
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentValue = [Total Graduates]
VAR CurrentYear = SELECTEDVALUE('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE])
VAR PriorYearValue = 
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Graduates],
        'DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE] = FORMAT(VALUE(CurrentYear) - 1, "0")
    )
RETURN
    CurrentValue - PriorYearValue
measures.description: Year-over-year absolute change in graduates

measures.name: 3-Year Moving Avg
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentYear = SELECTEDVALUE('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE])
VAR YearTable = 
    FILTER(
        ALLSELECTED('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE]),
        VALUE('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE]) >= VALUE(CurrentYear) - 2 &&
        VALUE('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE]) <= VALUE(CurrentYear)
    )
VAR YearsCount = COUNTROWS(YearTable)
RETURN
    IF(
        YearsCount >= 2,
        CALCULATE(
            [Total Graduates],
            YearTable
        ) / YearsCount,
        BLANK()
    )
measures.description: Moving average of graduates over 3 years

measures.name: Total Period Growth %
measures.expression:
VAR MinYear = MIN('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE])
VAR MaxYear = MAX('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE])
VAR FirstYearValue = 
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Graduates],
        'DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE] = MinYear
    )
VAR LastYearValue = 
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Graduates],
        'DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE] = MaxYear
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(
        LastYearValue - FirstYearValue,
        FirstYearValue,
        BLANK()
    )
measures.description: Total growth from first to last year - Fixed to avoid placeholder errors
measures.optimizationNotes: Fixed placeholder error by using variables instead of measures

measures.name: CAGR
measures.expression:
VAR MinYear = MIN('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE])
VAR MaxYear = MAX('DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE])
VAR FirstYearValue = 
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Graduates],
        'DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE] = MinYear
    )
VAR LastYearValue = 
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Graduates],
        'DataFileRecordLayout'[REF_DATE] = MaxYear
    )
VAR YearsCount = VALUE(MaxYear) - VALUE(MinYear)
RETURN
    IF(
        YearsCount > 0 && FirstYearValue > 0,
        POWER(LastYearValue / FirstYearValue, 1 / YearsCount) - 1,
        BLANK()
    )
measures.description: Compound annual growth rate over the entire period - Fixed to avoid placeholder errors
measures.optimizationNotes: Fixed placeholder error, robust year calculation

measures.name: Growth Trend Indicator
measures.expression:
VAR YoYChange = [Graduates YofY Change (%)]
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ISBLANK(YoYChange), "–",
        YoYChange > 0.02, "↑ Increase",
        YoYChange < -0.02, "↓ Decrease",
        "→ Stable"
    )
measures.description: Visual indicator: Up arrow, down arrow, or neutral based on YoY change

measures.name: % of Total Graduates
measures.expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Total Graduates],
    CALCULATE([Total Graduates], ALL('DataFileRecordLayout')),
    BLANK()
)
measures.description: Percentage of current selection vs total across all contexts

measures.name: Number of Fields of Study
measures.description: Number of distinct fields of study
